about.title: Quince
about.subtitle: Multi-channel audio logger.
index.filterTitle: Show only channels whose name contains the typed text (case-insensitive).
index.runStateFilterTitle: Click cycles through the status filter: All → Running → Stopped → Error → Silent
index.metadataFilterTitle: Click cycles through the metadata-status filter: All → Metadata errors → No metadata
index.emptyNoChannels: No channels configured. Add YAML configs to the config/ folder.
index.bulkEditButtonTitle: Apply the same settings to every checked channel
channelCard.bulkSelectTitle: Select this channel for bulk edit
channelCard.playTitle: Listen to the channel in your browser (this computer's default audio output)
channelCard.outputTitle: This channel's audio file format and save location
channelEdit.nameTitle: Display name of the channel (also used in logs and statuses).
channelEdit.sourceTypeTitle: Where the audio is captured from: a network stream (Icecast/HLS) or a local sound card.
channelEdit.streamUrlTitle: Address of the audio stream (Icecast/HLS playlist).
channelEdit.streamTypeTitle: Stream format: Icecast, or HLS (.m3u8 playlist).
channelEdit.streamTypeMismatchUrlIsHls: The URL looks like an HLS playlist (.m3u8), but the type is set to "Icecast" — "same as input" output will be saved as MP3, even though the real stream is likely AAC. You may want to switch the type to "HLS".
channelEdit.streamTypeMismatchTypeIsHls: The type is set to "HLS", but the URL doesn't look like an .m3u8 playlist. Double-check this is really an HLS link.
channelEdit.hlsIndexTitle: If the HLS playlist has multiple audio tracks/bitrates — index of the one to use (0 — first).
channelEdit.allowHttpTitle: Allow connecting over plain HTTP if the stream doesn't support HTTPS.
channelEdit.allowInvalidSslTitle: Don't validate the server's SSL certificate (for streams with a self-signed/expired certificate).
channelEdit.metadataUrlTitle: Stream metadata mode: empty — don't collect, "icy" — Icecast's built-in ICY metadata, any other value — a discovered HLS metadata JSON endpoint. Can be entered manually or filled in with the button on the right.
channelEdit.detectButtonTitle: Detect metadata (track title) availability using the current URL/stream type settings — the result will fill the field on the left
channelEdit.deviceTitle: List of recording devices currently detected on the system. Selecting one fills in the device name and UID below.
channelEdit.refreshDevicesTitle: Refresh the device list (e.g. after plugging in a USB microphone)
channelEdit.deviceUidTitle: Unique device identifier — used for matching first and resilient to device index changes on USB reconnection.
channelEdit.deviceNameTitle: Display name of the device — filled in automatically when chosen from the list above; used for matching only if the UID isn't set.
channelEdit.livewireRefreshTitle: Refresh the list of discovered channels
channelEdit.livewireNoChannelsFoundListe: No channels found. Auto-discovery is listening on port {0} but hasn't received any Advertisement packets yet — wait a few seconds and refresh, or check in "App Settings" that the right network interface is selected, and that nothing blocks multicast traffic. Use manual channel number entry below for now.
channelEdit.livewireStatusDisabled: Auto-discovery is disabled — no Livewire network interface is selected in "App Settings".
channelEdit.livewireStatusDisconnected: Livewire is disconnected — click "Connect" in "App Settings", next to the interface picker.
channelEdit.livewireStatusNicNotFound: Auto-discovery is disabled — the selected network interface wasn't found or has no IPv4 address.
channelEdit.livewireStatusSocketError: Auto-discovery is disabled — couldn't open the network socket: {0}
channelEdit.livewireStatusListeningWithT: Listening on interface {0} — last packet received {1} ago
channelEdit.livewireStatusListeningNoTra: Listening on interface {0} — no packets received yet
channelEdit.livewireChannelNumberTitle: Livewire channel number (1-65535) — the multicast address is computed from it automatically.
channelEdit.livewireChannelNameTitle: Display name of the channel — filled in automatically when chosen from the list above, or entered manually.
channelEdit.savePathTitle: Disk folder or network path where this channel's audio files will be saved. Created automatically if it doesn't exist yet.
channelEdit.browseTitle: Browse a folder on the disk of the server running the Quince.Service process
channelEdit.dateFolderTitle: Subfolder name template based on the recording date, e.g. YYYY-MM-DD.
channelEdit.fileNameFormatTitle: Recording file name template, e.g. hh-mm-ss.
channelEdit.fileDurationTitle: After how many minutes the current recording file is closed and a new one started.
channelEdit.retentionTitle: After how many days this channel's old recordings are deleted automatically (0 — never delete).
channelEdit.recordAudioTitle: If off, the channel only shows level meters without saving to disk.
channelEdit.autoStartTitle: Start recording automatically when the service starts (and right after the channel is created/appears).
channelEdit.outputModeTitle: "Same as input" — output format isn't set separately; "Set below" — opens file format/bitrate/sample rate/channels settings.
channelEdit.fileFormatTitle: Format of the saved audio files.
channelEdit.sampleRateTitle: Sample rate of the output file, Hz.
channelEdit.channelsTitle: Number of channels in the output file.
channelEdit.diskUsageRefreshTitle: Recalculate the current size of the recording folder
channelEdit.diskUsageNoPath: Set a save path to see the current usage.
channelEdit.diskUsageSummaryUnlimited: Retention is unlimited — no projected size limit. Recording folder currently uses: {0}.
channelEdit.diskUsageSummaryLimited: ≈{0} over {1} day(s) of retention at the current settings. Recording folder currently uses: {2} ({3}% of the projection).
channelEdit.diskUsageScanError: Couldn't determine the recording folder's size: {0}
channelEdit.silenceDetectorTitle: Stop recording to file during prolonged silence in the input signal and resume it once sound returns.
channelEdit.thresholdTitle: Volume level below which the signal is considered silence, dBFS.
channelEdit.triggerTitle: After how many seconds of continuous silence recording stops.
channelEdit.resumeTitle: After how many seconds of sound following silence recording resumes — the file is backfilled with that same amount of buffered audio from just before sound actually returned, so its start isn't lost.
channelEdit.dontStopRecordingTitle: The sound/silence status indicator keeps working as before, but recording to file no longer pauses/resumes — silence gets recorded too. Off by default.
channelEdit.errorNameExists: A channel with this name already exists.
channelEdit.errorSavePathRequired: Enter a save folder for recordings.
channelEdit.errorSavePathTimeout: The save folder is unavailable: timed out (the network path is not responding).
channelEdit.errorDeviceListWindows: Could not query the Windows audio subsystem (check that the "Windows Audio" service is running): {0}
channelEdit.errorDeviceListGeneric: Could not get the list of recording devices: {0}
channelEdit.errorLivewireChannelRequired: Enter the Livewire channel number (pick from the list or enter manually).
bulkEdit.title: Bulk edit — {0} channel(s) selected
bulkEdit.hint: Only check the settings you want to apply — everything else stays as-is for each channel.
bulkEdit.errorNothingChecked: Check at least one setting to apply.
clone.title: Clone channel?
clone.body: A new channel "{0} (copy)" will be created with the same configuration. The clone's auto-start is disabled so two engines don't run against the same source at once.
delete.title: Delete channel?
delete.body: The channel "{0}" and its config file ({1}) will be deleted permanently. Already recorded audio files are not deleted.
appSettings.title: Application settings
appSettings.showTpIndicatorsTitle: Show the True Peak meter on every channel card. Turning it off fully stops the card-level indicator module (the meter is neither shown nor computed).
appSettings.reconnectDelayTitle: Pause before retrying a connection after a stream/device drop, in seconds. Applies immediately to all already-running channels.
appSettings.reconnectMaxTitle: After this many consecutive failed reconnect attempts, the channel stops and an ERROR is logged, instead of retrying forever. 0 — unlimited.
appSettings.playoutBufferTitle: For Icecast/soundcard/Livewire sources, the level meter and browser listen-in lag the real broadcast by this many seconds — a small cushion for ordinary network/scheduling jitter. HLS channels aren't covered by this setting: they size their own delay automatically from their playlist's segment duration (smooths the wait for the next segment). Applies to channels on their next start/restart, not to already-running ones.
appSettings.livewireNicTitle: The network adapter connected to the Livewire AoIP network — shared by every Livewire channel and by auto-discovery. "None" means Livewire isn't used on this server.
appSettings.livewireNicHint: The "Connect"/"Disconnect" button next to it opens and closes the discovery socket right now, without saving or restarting the app. "Save" below locks in the choice for later (including auto-connect on the next app start); already-running Livewire channels pick up the new interface the next time they restart.
appSettings.livewireConnectTitle: Open/close the Livewire discovery socket on the selected interface — doesn't require an app restart. While disconnected, the "Livewire" source type isn't offered for new channels.
appSettings.errorNicListGeneric: Could not get the list of network interfaces: {0}
appSettings.adKeywordsTitle: Words that, if present in a track's title/artist, mark the metadata entry as class "C" (advertisement) in the CSV — case-insensitive. Comma-separated.
appSettings.newsKeywordsTitle: Words that, if present in a track's title/artist, mark the metadata entry as class "N" (news) in the CSV — case-insensitive. Comma-separated.
indicators.channelNotFound: Channel not found (it may have been deleted).
indicators.maxTitle: Peak maximum since start/last reset — click resets all maximums for the channel
readme.notFound: README.md not found next to the application.
folderBrowser.title: Select folder
folderBrowser.pathTitle: You can type a path manually and press "Go" or Enter
folderBrowser.errorNotExists: The folder doesn't exist or is unavailable.
resourceMonitor.title: Resource monitor
resourceMonitor.hint: CPU time and memory used by the app's processes. Refreshes automatically every 2 seconds.
